introduction: Nevada weatherization accepts applications year-round through regional providers. The program arranges selected home-efficiency improvements after assessing an eligible property.
description: Nevada weatherization accepts applications year-round through regional providers. The program arranges selected home-efficiency improvements after assessing an eligible proper

sections.who: Income-qualified owners and renters can be considered. Rental property owners may have to contribute to some improvement costs, so discuss permission and cost arrangements before work starts.
sections.get: An assessment identifies suitable measures, potentially including insulation, air sealing or equipment work. The service is not an unrestricted repair allowance or a promise to replace every appliance.
sections.docs:
• Household income evidence requested by the regional provider.
  • Your address and owner or rental information.
  • Recent energy bills if requested.
  • Landlord contact details and any required consent.
sections.apply:
1. Find the regional provider

    The state’s July 2026 notice lists Community Services Agency, HELP of Southern Nevada and Rural Nevada Development Corporation, with different service areas.

  2. Request household intake

    Follow the Housing Division’s regional pathway and ask for the current household application.

  3. Complete assessment

    Allow the provider to assess the home and confirm approved work and any owner obligations.
sections.after: Keep appointment details and ask about scheduling or waiting lists. Discuss maintenance instructions after installation; estimated savings are not a guaranteed reduction in your bill.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nevada’s current regional weatherization announcement. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
